scope: local source validation and one bounded attempt to reach the phone UI; no IR enabled

source_change.live_analysis: reads luma relative to Image.getCropRect() and preserves the crop-local coordinate system
source_change.saved_yuv: packs each YUV plane using its row/pixel stride and crop origin; sidecar records output and source dimensions plus crop origin
source_change.cleanup: temporary packed plane arrays are cleared; partially written frame and metadata files are deleted on failure
source_change.diagnostic_log: reports buffer size and crop bounds without image pixels

coverage: padded row stride and non-unit pixel stride
plane-dimension bounds reject coordinates that would land in row padding

android_compile.result: aapt, javac, d8 and zipalign completed; unsigned APK aligned
android_compile.warnings: JDK source/target 8 deprecation and existing deprecated Android API notes

phone_attempt.foreground_blocker: System UI remained on Keyguard; the probe activity did not open

limitations: The phone did not exercise Image.getCropRect() because Keyguard blocked the app before camera startup.
Synthetic plane tests do not validate the Cityman HAL's real Image.Plane buffer layout or chroma crop alignment.
publication: local only; no commit, push, or PR
